_comment: Vietnam — the Import-Export Tariff (Biểu thuế xuất khẩu, nhập khẩu) as compiled at 5 April 2026. Vietnam publishes no machine-readable schedule of its own: the source is one 32 MB bilingual xlsx workbook, compiled by the Quang Ninh Customs Sub-Department and redistributed through a third-party law library, so acquisition is manual, like the Dominican Republic's, with no scheduled refresh. The workbook is fetched by hand into data/vn_tariff_source/.vn_download/ and scripts/hts_automation/parse_vn_tariff.py converts it, emitting the tariff CSV this spec consumes in BOTH languages (vn_tariff_<year>_rev_<n>.csv and .vi.csv, same codes and indents in the same order, + the .meta.json effective date the manual adapter reads) plus the legal-notes corpus under data/hts_notes/. Codes are 4/6/8 digits and the schedule never goes to 10, so max_depth is 8 — not 10 like Malaysia. Hierarchy is STATED by the source (the row's type cell encodes its depth) rather than inferred from printed dashes.
_comment_authority: The workbook is NOT the issuing instrument. Vietnam enacts its schedule by Government / Ministry of Finance Decree, and the Decree is the citable authority; each rate cell in the source names its own Decree and effective date (MFN_DECREE, MFN_EFFECTIVE in the CSV) so a published rate can be cited. Anything built from this file should say so. The decrees the workbook cites are listed in SOURCES.md; its rates must be spot-checked against them before VN is activated.
_comment_ch98: Chapter 98 is Vietnam's own special-preference chapter — alternative duty lines for specified goods otherwise classified in chapters 1-97 — and it behaves differently from the AHTN schedule in three ways the loader has to know about: its rows carry no type marker (depth comes from the printed dash prefix), its UNIT column is empty because the source overloads it with the chapter 1-97 code each line maps to (moved to CORRESPONDING_CODES), and so its leaf flag comes from IS_LEAF rather than from a unit of quantity. See load_rows_vn() in build_hts_corpus.py.
_comment_lang: lang is en: the English CSV is the default build. languages [vi] adds the Vietnamese corpus ({namespace}_vi), Explorer dataset (.vi.json) and chapters (chapters_vn.vi.json), as TW does with zh and KR with ko. The workbook prints English for every chapter 1-97 line; chapter 98 has English on 447 of its 531 lines only because the parser composes it from the corresponding chapter 1-97 codes, so the Vietnamese corpus is the only one in which all of chapter 98 carries the source's own words.
_comment_revision: Revision ids follow the {year}_rev_{number} convention every jurisdiction uses. A dated edition takes MMDD of its effective date as the number, as CH (901), KR (101) and TW (729) do: the workbook compiled as at 5 April 2026 is 2026_rev_405.
_comment_verify: Copied from DO. The first edition has no predecessor, so verify passes with a warning; the thresholds guard the next edition.
